messages:
marta: Auditor ping 11 They want a tiny, auditable handoff that shows: our RBAC change flow (approvals + gated merge), KMS key usage for any remediation, and a clear incidents->change crosswalk. Keep it lean.

lee: We can produce a 1-zip package: PR slice from infra-policies (label `audit:rbac-change`), GitHub org audit NDJSON, CI run metadata (pipeline_id + status), CloudTrail KMS events limited to affected CMKs, and an incidents crosswalk CSV.

nina: Locations I'll drop to: 
- s3://org-audit-exports/prs/3102468000-prslice.json
- s3://org-audit-exports/github-audit/3102468000-audit.ndjson
- s3://org-audit-exports/ci-runs/3102468000-ci.json
- s3://org-audit-exports/cloudtrail/kms/3102468000-kms.ndjson
- s3://org-audit-exports/crosswalks/3102468000-crosswalk.csv

lee: Quick queries to include in the mapping doc so the auditor can validate: 
- Athena (GitHub audit)
  SELECT created_at, action, actor_login, repo, metadata->>'pr_number' AS pr_number
  FROM github_audit
  WHERE action IN ('pull_request.reviewed','pull_request.merged')
    AND repo='infra-policies'
    AND created_at BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30';

- Glue/CloudTrail (KMS)
  SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.accountId AS principal_account, requestParameters.keyId AS key_arn, eventID
  FROM cloudtrail_kms
  WHERE eventSource='kms.amazonaws.com'
    AND eventName IN ('Encrypt','Decrypt','GenerateDataKey','RotateKey','CreateKey')
    AND requestParameters.keyId IN ('arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234-efgh-5678');

- Splunk (incidents crosswalk)
  index=incidents sourcetype=triage_notes earliest=-365d "remediates:" OR "PR#"
  | rex "(?i)remediates:\s*PR[# ]?(?<pr>\d+)"
  | stats values(pr) as prs values(commit_sha) as commits by incident_id, short_description

marta: Important: auditor specifically asked for evidence showing approval gate (two approvers) and CI gating. Include the PR's approvals array and the CI run object with pipeline_id + final status. Redact tokens/credentials.

nina: We'll include an anonymized example PR link (internal): https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra-policies/pull/853 (redacted). PR JSON will contain `reviews` array and `merge_commit_sha` fields.

lee: For KMS linkage: if remediation required a key rotation, include the rotation runbook reference (docs/playbooks/kms-rotation.md) plus the CloudTrail RotateKey/CreateKey events and the deploy pipeline run that executed verification. Also include key ARNs and CloudTrail eventIDs.

marta: Retention justification item: attach signed snapshot of log retention policy and security lead approval. Confluence snapshot URL: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/log-retention-v3 (we will include signed PDF).

nina: I'll assemble the crosswalk CSV with columns: incident_id, incident_date, triage_note_snippet, referenced_prs, commit_shas, related_kms_key_arns, remediation_summary. That should satisfy the auditor linking ask.

lee: Action items: nina export PR slice + GH audit slice (EOD), lee export CloudTrail KMS events (include ARNs + eventIDs), marta compile mapping doc and signed retention PDF, evidence-bot zip and post the bundle.

evidence-bot: Evidence bundle queued for upload. Contents: pr_slice.json, github_audit.ndjson, ci_runs.json, cloudtrail_kms.ndjson, incident_crosswalk.csv, retention_signed.pdf.

auditor-bot: Please include a redacted example where a vulnerability led to a key rotation and show the RotateKey eventID + post-rotation verification log. Ticket AUD-2301 referencing this bundle.

nina: Will include a redacted crosswalk row showing exactly that case (incident_id INC-2025-089, PR#853, RotateKey eventID evt-0a1b2c3d).

evidence-bot: Upload complete: s3://org-audit-exports/bundles/3102468000-evidence.zip (checksum sha256: f1c2d3e4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d). Presigned link available for 48h.

marta: Great. I'll send the one-page mapping to the auditor and offer scoped S3 access for raw NDJSON for 48h if they need deeper inspection. :thumbsup:
